I am currently a Masters student with a passion in data analytics,
statistics, and communicating complex information
through engaging visualisations.

Throughout my studies, I have developed experience in Python,
R, SQL, statistical analysis, and data storytelling.

This website is a space for sharing my projects,
exploring interesting research, and translating
technical findings into accessible insights.
